sentences.text: La carta era de su hermano Tomás.
sentences.english: The letter was from his brother Tomás.

sentences.text: Tomás vivía lejos, en otra ciudad.
sentences.english: Tomás lived far away, in another city.

sentences.text: Pedro abrió la carta y la leyó.
sentences.english: Pedro opened the letter and read it.

sentences.text: Tomás escribió: «Voy a visitarlos el sábado, porque quiero ver a todos.»
sentences.english: Tomás wrote: "I'm going to visit you on Saturday, because I want to see everyone."

sentences.text: Le dijo a Rosa: —Tomás va a venir a vernos.
sentences.english: He said to Rosa, "Tomás is going to come to see us."
"When is he going to arrive?" asked Rosa.

sentences.text: Rosa dijo: —Tenemos que preparar la casa.
sentences.english: Rosa said, "We have to get the house ready."

sentences.text: Marta limpió la mesa y Luis puso las sillas.
sentences.english: Marta cleaned the table and Luis set out the chairs.

sentences.text: El sábado Tomás llegó con una bolsa grande.
sentences.english: On Saturday Tomás arrived with a big bag.

sentences.text: Les dio un regalo a los niños.
sentences.english: He gave the children a present.

sentences.text: Pedro lo abrazó y todos comieron juntos.
sentences.english: Pedro hugged him and they all ate together.
